exact_semantics: All coordinates use normalized immutable dyadics numerator/2^shift. Zero is (0,0); a nonzero numerator is odd when shift is nonzero. Every operation owns a fresh big integer, never uses float or big.Rat and never mutates or aliases an input. Shift and integer conversions are portable to 386; obvious oversize work is rejected before large allocation, every normalized result is gated by exact bits, and operations charge platform-independent logical 64-bit limbs rather than machine big.Word units.
expansion_semantics: Every glyph/root is expanded from phase-one private real raw controls; simple and empty controls begin as exact integers and no implied point is synthesized. The disk matrix xscale,scale01,scale10,yscale maps x'=xscale*x+scale10*y and y'=scale01*x+yscale*y. Nested components remain exact with no per-level rounding and no child header bbox substitution. Transform-point visits count repeated and depth-amplified work across every root before exact expansion.
offset_semantics: UNSCALED_COMPONENT_OFFSET and the phase-one default apply M*p+integerOffset. SCALED_COMPONENT_OFFSET applies M*(p+integerOffset). ROUND_XY_TO_GRID was rejected upstream and instructions remain opaque and unexecuted.
point_match_semantics: Point attachment transforms the child first, then translates by accumulatedParent[arg1]-transformedChild[arg2] and adds that exact translation to every child control. Indices address expanded real controls only; implied points do not exist and phantom-point attachment was rejected upstream. An empty child is valid only for XY placement.
bbox_semantics: Simple bboxes retain the phase-one exact raw-control invariant. Compound minima are mathematical floor of exact minima and maxima are mathematical ceil of exact maxima; no-control glyphs require zero bounds. head is the exact union of glyphs with contours. Q26.6 and implied points are not used.
metrics_semantics: hhea minLSB, minRSB and xMaxExtent are recomputed with checked arithmetic over glyphs with contours; an empty set requires zero. head flag bit 1, when set, asserts xMin equals lsb for every glyph including empty and zero-contour glyphs; when clear it is recorded as unset_not_asserted. The last flagged direct USE_MY_METRICS component wins recursively; every flagged matrix is identity and the composite hmtx advance and lsb equal the ultimate source, whose GID is bound per glyph.
descriptor_hash_semantics: The descriptor hash is SHA-256 over u64be(len(descriptor_hash_profile)) followed by its exact UTF-8 bytes, then u64be(len(canonical_descriptor_json)) followed by the exact minified encoding/json bytes of this ordered map-free descriptor. It is lowercase hex with the sha256: prefix.
hash_semantics: The geometry hash is streaming SHA-256 over the declared preimage. str is u64be(len(UTF-8 bytes)) followed by the exact UTF-8 bytes; u8, u32 and u64 are unsigned fixed-width big-endian integers; i32 is its two's-complement uint32 bit pattern encoded big-endian. A dyadic is sign u8 (zero=0,positive=1,negative=2), shift u32, magnitude length u64 and minimal unsigned big-endian magnitude; zero has shift and length zero. No JSON, map order, float or native integer enters the preimage.
geometry_hash_preimage: str(hash_profile),u32(schema),str(profile),str(descriptor_hash),str(source_profile),str(source_descriptor_hash),str(source_graph_hash),str(upstream_content_profile),str(upstream_content_hash),u32(glyph_count); per gid: u32(gid),u8(kind empty=0/simple=1/compound=2),u8(has_contours false=0/true=1),u64(contours),each u32(endpoint),u64(points),each dyadic(x),dyadic(y),u8(on_curve false=0/true=1),i32(xMin,yMin,xMax,yMax),u32(advance),i32(lsb),u32(effective_metric_source); then i32(head bbox four,hhea minLSB,minRSB,xMaxExtent),str(head_lsb_status).
resource_semantics: Let R,G,P,C,E,I,T,O,L,B be revalidated source-graph canonical bytes, root glyphs, all-root expanded point/contour/edge instances, all-root recursive glyph expansion instances, transform-point visits, exact operations, logical limb units and geometry canonical bytes. Before source rehash, a checked receipt-only admission lower bound includes R and all then-known G,P,C,E,I,O,L,B minima; the source graph is then rehashed and its actual canonical bytes must equal R. I=G+E because every expanded edge invokes one non-root glyph; a graph DP verifies I and gates I and T before expansion, including zero-control component DAGs. work=R+64G+16P+8C+32E+16I+12T+8O+L+B. After topology, fixed charges including verified R, I and T are bound before metrics or expansion. One shared incremental work meter always reserves the known lower bounds for O, L and B, charges every exact operation, logical limb unit and geometry canonical byte before that work proceeds, and finally must equal the receipt formula exactly. retained=source_retained+32768+64G+owned_receipt_string_bytes. working=69632+24G+3*max_root_points*(32+2*(64+ceil(exact_bits_limit/8)))+8*max_root_contours+128*(max_depth+1). Values are checked portable logical charges, not allocator or RSS measurements.
ownership_semantics: Validation borrows the immutable OutlineFont for the call; success retains it and compact scalar per-glyph metadata only. Exact points and scratch are operation-local, no mutable cache or slice view is exposed, and concurrent reads are safe.
cancellation_semantics: A non-nil context is checked before work, through topology preflight, expansion, exact arithmetic, attachment, bbox, metrics, hashing and immediately before publication. Cancellation publishes nil and a zero receipt.
failure_semantics: Invalid source bindings, exact/resource overflow, geometry/bbox/metrics mismatch, cancellation, allocation failure and invariant drift fail closed with nil GeometryFont and a strictly zero receipt.
capability_semantics: This stage validates exact real control geometry only. Commands, implied points, Q26.6, shaping, layout, raster and cutly.text.pinned-font-viewport-px.v2 remain unauthorized; no capability is advertised.
excluded_responsibilities: Implied-point synthesis, Move/Line/Quad/Close materialization, Q26.6 rounding, GDEF/GSUB/GPOS, go-text/HarfBuzz shaping, bidi, fallback, raster, paint, encoding, persistence and publication are outside this profile.
